notes.title: 2.0 Multiplayer and Dodgeball Release
notes.notes:
Some of the changes include:
- Networked, Peer-to-Peer online multiplayer
- A brand new Dodgeball level 
- Support for more screen sizes
- Burger power ups
- Seasons
- Weather
- Time of Day
- Holidays
- New Achievements
- Secret Easter Eggs (Eugene password protects his car)
- Bug fixes beyond your imagination

notes.title: 2.0 Online Update
notes.notes: After much work and time, we have completed online multiplayer for Super Totally Ultimate Dad Showdown!  In addition, we have a new game mode to celebrate!  Numerous bugs have been fixed, we have some new dadchievements to collect, and we will consider this our final content update.  Thank you all so much for your support!

notes.title: Launch Status Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053630/55741f3a453eae40fe596e21dbd48016c25abbb5.png
A quick update on the status of our launch:

Unfortunately, we encountered some unexpected last-minute issues with the game build that we determined would be a big issue to the overall gameplay experience to unfortunately warrant a delay in our launch. The team is currently working to resolve these issues so that you can get your hands on the release as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience and understanding,

The Super Totally Ultimate Dad Showdown Team

notes.title: Patch Notes for April 21
notes.notes:
0.5.3 is a minor update aimed at improving the player experience in The Dad Depot:

 Replaced Garden Center water spills with fire hydrant-style water spurts
Fixed bug that prevented player input when trying to navigate to the main menu from the pause menu


Thanks for playing STUDS! If you haven't yet, please consider joining our community Discord to chat with the devs, find people to play with, and provide feedback: https://discord.gg/bQY7pHkh

notes.title: Early Access Update #1
notes.notes:
We've been working hard to implement your feedback for our first major update. Players wanted more ways to mess with their friends in the stroller race, so we've added new obstacles that are only activated by players. Keep an eye out for some crates that drop throughout the level. Players also expressed confusion with the shopping list in The Dad Depot, so we've made some adjustments to the required items, and replaced the shopping list text with images of the required items. These are just some of the many changes, fixes, and improvements we've made over the last few weeks since launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053630/c759ad9ab952e3c0cbbc2171e455c91073adce31.png

STROLLER RACE

 Added four player-controlled obstacle events
 Added an arrow to indicate the location of a player’s stroller
 Adjusted placement & difficulty of various obstacles


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053630/4d903556644ced8fa9b7fea8f7a02581161c180c.png

SHOPPING SPREE

 Replaced shopping list text with images
 Shopping items that have been placed on carts now cannot be grabbed by other players if a player is actively holding the cart
 Added an exclamation point above the player's head when near a shopping item
 Removed “SlowSign” as a required shopping item
 Removed “Propane” as a required shopping item (exploding propane is still active)
 Added “Vacuum” as a required shopping item
 Increased the number of randomized forklifts by 1
 Almost doubled the raising/lowering animation speed of the forklifts
 Slightly increased the wait time before being able to interact with the forklifts after activation


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40053630/e93e95495f857bbe2368c418dda2abece4a5a4f9.png
 
SOUND

 Added new main menu music
 Added sounds for button clicks


GENERAL

 Added early access notice on game startup
 Added functionality to hide mouse cursor outside of menus
 Modified the descriptions in the level select to represent the recommended number of players for each game mode
 Redirected menu “Feedback” to our community Discord server instead of our website

 
KNOWN BUGS

 [strike]In Shopping Spree, when attempting to return to the main menu from the pause menu, the game no longer detects player input[/strike] FIXED
 Aspect ratio gets cropped on widescreen monitors
 Video settings menu: “graphics” and “resolution” default values are not accurately reflected in the dropdown menus. (Functionality still works when new options are selected by the player)
 Mouse cursor sometimes stays on screen outside of menus
 Closing the pause menu by pressing the “escape” key instead of clicking the “resume” button can lead to UI overlapping
 Music volume may sometimes fluctuate intermittently
 Stroller Race AI sometimes get stuck
 Victory scenes may not accurately reflect player placement after finishing a round



Thank you for playing STUDS in early access. This is just our first update; we look forward to bringing more content to you very soon! Please consider joining our community Discord to find people to play with, to report bugs, or to request new features: https://discord.gg/MvrPPpy6

notes.title: STUDS EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey dad bod enthusiasts. STUDS is now officially in Early Access. The developers have been working hard to bring you this awesome game. There will be regular updates to the game fixing any bugs that you may encounter.

Get a copy of STUDS  and invite your friends to play with you via remote play feature.

Questions? Comments about the game? Visit our website for more - https://www.dadshowdown.com/
